headline_marked: Jamaat-e-Islami [[monitoring viral video involving MP]] Gazi Nazrul Islam
headline: Jamaat-e-Islami monitoring viral video involving MP Gazi Nazrul Islam
summary: The party says it will take 'organisational measures' after verifying facts surrounding a video showing the lawmaker with a woman.
details: Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami is monitoring reports and a viral video involving Satkhira-4 (Shyamnagar) lawmaker Gazi Nazrul Islam.
The video, which has drawn widespread attention on social media, appears to show the lawmaker in a room with a woman.
In a statement, Gazi Nazrul Islam identified the woman as his second wife, Mariam Begum, and denied that the allegations surrounding the video were true.
Assistant Secretary General Ahsanul Mahboob Zubair stated that the party will gather more information and verify facts before taking any organizational measures.
Zubair noted that statements from the lawmaker, both of his wives, and a video statement from the father of the second wife have already been made public.
caption:
A viral video showing a Jamaat-e-Islami MP with a woman has sparked a party inquiry.

Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami is monitoring reports and a viral video involving Satkhira-4 (Shyamnagar) lawmaker Gazi Nazrul Islam.

The video, which has drawn widespread attention on social media, appears to show the lawmaker in a room with a woman.

In a statement, Gazi Nazrul Islam identified the woman as his second wife, Mariam Begum, and denied that the allegations surrounding the video were true.

Assistant Secretary General Ahsanul Mahboob Zubair stated that the party will gather more information and verify facts before taking any organizational measures.

Zubair noted that statements from the lawmaker, both of his wives, and a video statement from the father of the second wife have already been made public.

Source: Somoy News, The Daily Star, Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo

headline: ICT orders army to produce retired major Muzaffar on Thursday
summary: The International Crimes Tribunal (ICT) has ordered the Bangladesh Army to produce retired major Muzaffar Hossain on July 23.
details: The International Crimes Tribunal (ICT) has ordered the Bangladesh Army to produce retired major Muzaffar Hossain before the court on Thursday, July 23.
Muzaffar Hossain is being made an accused in the case regarding the assassination of former President Ziaur Rahman.
BNP Secretary General Abdel Hakim Rizvi has questioned who sheltered the convict for 45 years, demanding an investigation into his protectors.
The move comes as the tribunal continues to process the assassination case of the former president.
caption:
Who sheltered a Ziaur Rahman assassination convict for 45 years?

The International Crimes Tribunal (ICT) has ordered the Bangladesh Army to produce retired major Muzaffar Hossain before the court on Thursday, July 23.

Muzaffar Hossain is being made an accused in the case regarding the assassination of former President Ziaur Rahman.

BNP Secretary General Abdel Hakim Rizvi has questioned who sheltered the convict for 45 years, demanding an investigation into his protectors.

The move comes as the tribunal continues to process the assassination case of the former president.
